name: Louez
description: Open-source equipment rental platform: a branded booking storefront with live availability, plus a back office for reservations, customers, PDF contracts and revenue statistics.

LOUEZ_MODE.description: standalone hosts a single store at the root of the site, with the dashboard under /dashboard.

AUTH_URL.description: Public URL of this app — https://<the app name you chose above>.herokuapp.com, or your own domain. Sign-in is bound to it.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible endpoint for product images (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Scaleway, Backblaze B2...). Image uploads stay disabled until the five S3 values are set. Everything else works without them.

S3_REGION.description: Region of your bucket, e.g. eu-west-3.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key with read/write access to the bucket.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key paired with the access key.

S3_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public base URL of the bucket, or /files to serve images through the app when the bucket is private.

SMTP_HOST.description: Optional. Without SMTP credentials you sign in with a password and Louez skips sending mail.

SMTP_PORT.description: Optional. 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS on connect.
